name: Clipping Cube and Cutting Plane Interaction
definition: Interaction techniques for selective clipping of volume objects using a Clipping Cube (axis-aligned, resizable via corner spheres) and a Cutting Plane (arbitrary alignment), implemented via client-side widgets controlling server-side RTVR clipping capabilities.
summary: Clipping Cube and Cutting Plane Interaction is a focus-plus-context method that renders a clipped volume interior as solid geometry while depicting the exterior as non-photorealistic contours to reduce visual clutter.
